name: Handsome Laundering -the mystic lover-
original_name: ハンサムロンダリング -the mystic lover-
source:
What we come to know
Is it love, or is it malice?

In the heart of the city lies the popular laundry cafe, L&L café space.
A rumor quietly circulates about this shop:
"They take on secret requests... and grant the wishes of those in trouble."

After a certain incident, you find yourself knocking on the door of L&L.
Together with the quirky staff who gather there, you set out to solve the case...

This new story begins with the audio drama as the prequel (Episode 0)!
A love-mystery adventure where bonds are forged through solving mysteries.
